The deterministic short-term read is ascending but fragmented, while a separate structure detector retains lower-high/lower-low evidence; this limits trend persistence.
Short-horizon ATR materially exceeds ATR14, showing recent realized-range expansion rather than stable compression.
Latest volume is below its trailing average, while two immediately preceding sessions were above average; participation is mixed rather than a confirmed directional expansion.
